out-of-the-dark-talking-to-mistag.speaker: Mistag
out-of-the-dark-talking-to-mistag.text: It is good to see you again! The Dorgeshuun Council would like to ask a favour of you, if you are interested?

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: Surface-dwellers have been visiting the mines for some time now, but no Dorgeshuun has yet visited the surface.

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: We are curious about the surface, and we are also worried about the dangers it poses. We know that Lumbridge is friendly but we are worried that the HAM group may be plotting against us.

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: We are planning to send an agent to the surface and we would like you to act as a guide.

steps.prompt: Start the Death to the Dorgeshuun quest?

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: Thank you!

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: In order to get into the HAM base undetected you will both need to go in disguise. You should get two full sets of HAM robes. Once you have them, our agent will meet you in the cellar of Lumbridge castle.

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: Oh dear! Our agent is ready, but the Council will not let an expedition go ahead without a guide. If you reconsider, please let me know!

options.text: Can I sell you some ore?

steps.player: Can I sell you some ore?

steps.text: If the player has no unnoted iron or silver ore in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: Certainly. I will buy any iron or silver ore you mine. Speak to me again when you have some.
If the player has unnoted iron or silver ore in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: I will give you [X] gold pieces for the ore you are carrying.

options.text: Why do the Dorgeshuun live underground?

steps.player: Why do the Dorgeshuun live underground?

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: Our ancient legends say that goblins were created by an evil god in order to fight in a huge war. This god sent the Dorgeshuun tribe to fight a battle where all would die.

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: But our ancestors escaped by hiding in a deep hole in the ground where our god could not find us. Eventually an earthquake sealed the hole and they were forever safe.

options.text: The war is over now, so you can return to the surface.

steps.player: The war is over now, so you can return to the surface.

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: Even if the gods are no longer at war, I find it hard to believe that a tribe of peaceful goblins would be safe above. I have heard of humans coming down into the caves to slaughter our people!

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: But even if we could return, we would not want to. We are adapted to living underground, and we have built a home for ourselves that we do not want to leave.

options.text: What was the name of your god?

steps.player: What was the name of your god?

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: Our ancestors did not speak his name, thinking that to do so would attract his attention. His name has been unspoken for so long that it is now entirely forgotten.

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: That is for the best. We have survived perfectly well without gods, and we do not want a return to the old ways.

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: I lost it in a mining accident a few years ago.

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: This area is very unstable. That's why we put markers on the wall showing the safest path.

options.text: Can you show me the way out of the mines?

steps.player: Can you show me the way out of the mines?

steps.speaker: Mistag
steps.text: Certainly. Come back soon!
Mistag shows you the way through the tunnels.

out-of-the-dark-talking-to-zanik.speaker: Zanik
out-of-the-dark-talking-to-zanik.text: You must be the famous [player name]!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Pleased to meet you! I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I can't wait to see the surface! But first you need to get us both sets of HAM robes.

options.text: Where do I get the robes?

steps.player: Where do I get the robes?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: How should I know? You're the surface-dweller! Maybe you could steal them from the HAM people or something.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: We'll need two sets of full robes: shirt, robe, hood, cloak, gloves, boots and badge.

options.text: Aren't you scared of the surface?

steps.player: Aren't you scared of the surface?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Well... a bit. All our legends say it's a terrible place.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: But that's a bad reason not to visit it. Maybe the legends are wrong. Or even if they're right, we should know for sure.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: And I've always wondered... what's beyond the next cave? What's at the end of every tunnel? The surface is a whole new world to explore, and I can't wait!

options.text: What's that mark on your forehead?

steps.player: What's that mark on your forehead?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I, er, er...

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: To be honest I don't know. It happened when...

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: If you don't mind, I'd rather not talk about it now. Maybe once you've shown me some of the surface.

options.condition: After choosing at least one dialogue option:

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: See you soon!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Oh well.

out-of-the-dark-talking-to-zanik-without.speaker: Zanik
out-of-the-dark-talking-to-zanik-without.text: Hi [player name]! Have you got our disguises yet?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I'm so looking forward to seeing the surface. But the Council insists that I get the disguise first.

options.text: Where do I get the robes?
Aren't you scared of the surface?
What's that mark on your forehead?

out-of-the-dark-talking-to-zanik-with-tw.speaker: Zanik
out-of-the-dark-talking-to-zanik-with-tw.text: Hi [player name]! Have you got our disguises yet?

out-of-the-dark-talking-to-zanik-with-tw.player: Yes, I have two sets of robes!

out-of-the-dark-talking-to-zanik-with-tw.text: If the player has a follower with them

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: You should pick up your pet thingy. It would only get in the way.

out-of-the-dark-talking-to-zanik-with-tw.speaker: Zanik
out-of-the-dark-talking-to-zanik-with-tw.text: All right, let's go! I can't wait to see all around Lumbridge!
Zanik takes a set of H.A.M. robes from you.

out-of-the-dark-talking-to-zanik-after-g.speaker: Zanik
out-of-the-dark-talking-to-zanik-after-g.text: What are we waiting for? Let's go!

options.text: I need to do something else for a bit.

steps.player: I need to do something else for a bit.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: All right. I'll wait for you in the castle cellar.

options.text: Aren't you going to put on your disguise?

steps.player: Aren't you going to put on your disguise?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: There's no need for that yet. Why don't you show me around Lumbridge first? I'm so excited about visiting the surface!

options.text: Will you tell me about the mark on your forehead?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I, er...

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I will tell you, [player name], but not just yet. Finish showing me around Lumbridge and then I'll tell you.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Okay!

out-of-the-dark-talking-to-zanik-after-d.speaker: Zanik
out-of-the-dark-talking-to-zanik-after-d.text: Are you ready to finish our tour now?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Well then, let's go!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-zanik-in-.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-zanik-in-.text: Where are we? I thought that ladder led to the surface.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-zanik-in-.player: We are on the surface! We're in Lumbridge Castle!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-zanik-in-.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-zanik-in-.text: It's so enclosed, it could almost be underground. Let's go outside, [player name]! I want to see the sun!

options.text: I need to do something else for a bit.
Aren't you going to put on your disguise?
Will you tell me about the mark on your forehead?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-outside-the-.text: A cutscene begins, and the camera zooms up and out into the sky.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-outside-the-.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-outside-the-.text: It's so bright! I can't look at it!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-outside-the-.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-outside-the-.text: But it's amazing to think that there's nothing above me. Just the sun and the air and empty space, forever...

a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-outside-the-.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-outside-the-.text: For generations my people have lived with rock over our heads. But now I can see the sky!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-trying-to-enter-the-.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-trying-to-enter-the-.text: We can't go into the HAM lair yet! I'm not wearing my disguise!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-trying-to-enter-the-.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-trying-to-enter-the-.text: You said you'd show me around Lumbridge before we went down there, [player name].

a-tour-of-lumbridge-trying-to-enter-dorg.speaker: Cave goblin guard
a-tour-of-lumbridge-trying-to-enter-dorg.text: Surface-dweller! You may not pass through that door!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-trying-to-enter-dorg.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-trying-to-enter-dorg.text: I'm sorry, [player name]. I'd like to show you around the city, but the council has decided not to let any surface-dwellers in yet.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-a-man-or-.speaker: Man
a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-a-man-or-.text: A cave goblin? Well, there goes the neighbourhood!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-a-man-or-.speaker: Man
a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-a-man-or-.text: It's all very well the duke signing a peace treaty with those creatures. Maybe that'll stop them attacking us.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-a-man-or-.speaker: Man
a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-a-man-or-.text: But for them to come wandering around the surface and mixing with decent people? I don't know, what's the world coming to?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-a-man-or-.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-a-man-or-.text: We were never going to attack you! YOU nearly attacked US!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-a-man-or-.speaker: Man
a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-a-man-or-.text: Oh, they may say they're civilised, but they're still goblins. You can't trust them. The only reason they're not a threat is that they're so stupid.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-a-man-or-.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-talking-to-a-man-or-.text: Stop talking about me like I'm not here!

steps.speaker: Man
steps.text: Keep away from me you dirty goblin!

steps.speaker: Man
steps.text: I don't know, what will be next? Cave goblins LIVING up here? Taking our jobs? I wouldn't want my daughter to marry a goblin!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I'm not sure a Dorgeshuun would want to marry a human!

steps.speaker: Man
steps.text: What rudeness! This is why they say goblins have no manners!

steps.speaker: Man
steps.text: Oh, I've got nothing against goblins in their own place. I just don't think they ought to be wandering around in our city and making the place look bad.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.text: Goblins wandering around Lumbridge and talking to the duke like they're normal people? I don't know what the world's coming to.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.text: It just makes me uncomfortable, is all. What if I was in bed and some horrible little goblin poked its head up through the floor?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: We would never do that! We don't tunnel upwards and we're very careful not to damage human cellars.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.text: You cave goblins... don't you, you know, eat people?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: No!

steps.speaker: Man
steps.text: Oh! Well, that's all right then.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-duke-horacio.speaker: Duke Horacio
a-tour-of-lumbridge-duke-horacio.text: It's good to see a visitor from the Dorgeshuun! I am Duke Horacio.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-duke-horacio.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-duke-horacio.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Headman Ur-Tag sends his greetings.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-duke-horacio.speaker: Duke Horacio
a-tour-of-lumbridge-duke-horacio.text: Tell Ur-Tag that I wish to speak with him again. I think that our cities could profit from trading with one another, but there can be little trade if he does not allow visitors to enter the city.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-duke-horacio.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-duke-horacio.text: I know! But the ruling council is so slow to make decisions. It's made up of old fogeys who are set in their ways.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-duke-horacio.speaker: Duke Horacio
a-tour-of-lumbridge-duke-horacio.text: Now then, child, there is room for caution and experience in politics.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-duke-horacio.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-duke-horacio.text: Maybe when I return I can convince them to open the gates of the city.

options.text: I'd like to get into the city too.

steps.player: I'd like to get into the city too.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I wish I could show it to you, [player name]!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Someday I will, but I don't think the council will agree to open the doors any time soon.

steps.speaker: Duke Horacio
steps.text: It basically defines the borders between our two societies. It's not usual for two states to be above one another rather than side-by-side!

steps.speaker: Duke Horacio
steps.text: Everything above ground, within the borders of Lumbridge, belongs to Lumbridge. Everything below ground belongs to the Dorgeshuun. Except for the cellars of our buildings, those belong to Lumbridge.

steps.speaker: Duke Horacio
steps.text: Of course both our underground systems might expand. Neither state can build new tunnels that are too close to the other's systems...

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: This is boring. Let's go.

options.text: Have you heard of any HAM activity lately?

steps.player: Have you heard of any HAM activity lately?

steps.speaker: Duke Horacio
steps.text: No... I know they've been gaining members but I haven't heard anything else from them. They may be planning something, but then again they may not.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-duke-horacio-talking.speaker: Duke Horacio
a-tour-of-lumbridge-duke-horacio-talking.text: Hello again, Zanik, [player name]. I hope you are enjoying your tour. Perhaps someday a human can have a similar tour of your city.

options.text: I'd like to get into the city too.
Have you heard of any HAM activity lately?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.speaker: Cook
a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.text: What, er, who is this? Is it a cave goblin?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.player: Zanik is the first cave goblin to visit the surface! I'm giving her a tour of Lumbridge.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.speaker: Cook
a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.text: Well, er, pleased to meet you, Zanik.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.speaker: Cook
a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.text: In fact, it's a good thing I met you. It's the Duke's birthday today, and I should be making him a lovely big birthday cake. I need eggs, flour and milk...

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.text: I don't know what those things are! Are they exotic surface foods?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.speaker: Cook
a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.text: Well, they're not exactly exotic, they're just the basic ingredients of a cake.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.text: If they're the basic ingredients, why don't you already have them?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.player: I don't think Zanik has time to help you.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.speaker: Cook
a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.text: It was worth a try. Anyway...

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.speaker: Cook
a-tour-of-lumbridge-cook.text: How is the adventuring going, my friend?

options.text: Do you have any other quests for me?
I am getting strong and mighty.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-crafting-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-crafting-tutor.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-crafting-tutor.speaker: Crafting tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-crafting-tutor.text: Hello there Zanik! How can I help?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-crafting-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-crafting-tutor.text: What's that thing with the wheel?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-crafting-tutor.speaker: Crafting tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-crafting-tutor.text: This is my spinning wheel! Look at the way it goes round and round and round...

a-tour-of-lumbridge-crafting-tutor.speaker: Crafting tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-crafting-tutor.text: It spins wool into balls so we can work it more easily.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-crafting-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-crafting-tutor.text: I don't know what wool is, but I'm sure it's fascinating!

options.text: How can I train my crafting?

steps.player: How can I train my crafting?

steps.text: If the player has level 1-9 Crafting:

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: To get started, you might like to try your hand at crafting some armour from cow's leather. There's a tanner just over in Al Kharid who could tan any hides for you.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Once you've managed to get your hand on some kind of leather, you just need a needle and some thread to get to work!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: If that doesn't take your fancy, you could try your hand at spinning wool right here on the spinning wheel.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Come to think of it... Farmer Fred, just north of here, sounds like he could use a hand shearing some of his sheep. Maybe you could help him out, and get some practice while you're at it.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you want to know?
If the player has level 10-19 Crafting:

steps.player: How can I train my crafting?

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Lots of budding craftsmen seem to spend their time here spinning Flax into bow strings on the wheel, if that takes your fancy.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Or you might like to try your hand at crafting some armour from cow's leather. There's a tanner just over in Al Kharid who could tan any hides for you.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you want to know?
If the player has level 20-99 Crafting:
If the player has below 99 Crafting:

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Now that you've got a little experience under your belt, the world's your oyster!
If the player has 99 Crafting:

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: I can't help but feel like I should be the one asking you! At this point, the world's your oyster!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: If you wanted to try your hand at making some jewellery, you'll want to get your hand on some gold and some kind of gem, with a mould to work with and a chisel at hand.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: But if that's not your thing, maybe you'd like to try making some more armour!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Cow's leather's a good place to start, but you can try all other kinds of hides, like a dragon's!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Glass blowing seems to be a popular trade, too. You can forge molten glass from some sand and soda ash, then make all kinds of things using a glass blowing pipe.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you want to know

options.text: What kinds of things can be crafted?

steps.player: What kinds of things can be crafted?

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: All kinds of things, really! You can make armour from leather, make some pottery, try your hand at glass blowing, make some jewellery, weapons even...

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: What would you like to hear about?

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Sure thing! Most armour you can craft just involves taking a needle and some thread to whatever material you can get your hands on.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: You might like to try with different kinds of animal hide, from cows, yaks, snakes, dragons... Or any other sort of fabric you can find!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Some crafty types have started making some leather- covered wooden shields recently, too!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: You might find some creatures make for a pretty sturdy helmet, too. The best way to make something like that's just to take a good old chisel to it!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Would you like to hear about anything else I mentioned?

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Of course! Pottery's all kind of the same, it just takes a lot of getting used to.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: All that there really is to it is getting your hands on some clay, getting it wet and getting to work on a potter's wheel.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Once you've got the shape you want out of it, you want to put it in a pottery oven to fire it up.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: The barbarians west of Varrock seem to be pretty keen on their pottery. I'd take a look around there, if you wanted to try it out!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Once you get the hang of it, you can make pots, pie dishes, bowls... You know.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Would you like to hear about anything else I mentioned?

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Glass blowing? Well, to get started you'll need to get yourself some molten glass. You can make some for yourself by heating sand and soda ash in a furnace.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Once you've got a hold of that, you'll want a glass blowing pipe to blow it out in to shape, before it cools down.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: It's not the easiest thing to get to grips with, but it shouldn't be too difficult!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Would you like to hear about anything else I mentioned?

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Sure. All it boils down to is a bar of gold or silver, some kind of cut gem if you're feeling fancy, and a mould to help shape the thing.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: You can use a chisel to make a gem really shine and sparkle. You wouldn't want to use an uncut one for any jewellery.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Once you've got all of your materials together, you'll want to use a furnace to actually craft whatever it is you're trying to make!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Wizards seem to like enchanting their jewellery to do all kinds of things, too, but I don't know a lot about that.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Would you like to hear about anything else I mentioned?

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Well, there aren't too many weapons that people tend to craft, but there are a couple worth noting!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Battlestaves are probably the most common. It boils down to fastening an orb of some kind onto the end of a battlestaff.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: You do need to get the orb in the first place, though... You can make one through glass blowing, but it's not much use without being charged.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: I can't help much with crafting it, though! There's a little more magic involved there than I'm familiar with.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Aside from battlestaves, there are a couple of weapons that people like to make from silver... Sickles and bolts, usually.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Would you like to hear about anything else I mentioned?

options.condition: If the player has already asked about something:

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you want to know?

options.text: How can I train my crafting?

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Well, just come back any time you want to know anything!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-banking-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-banking-tutor.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-banking-tutor.speaker: Banker tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-banking-tutor.text: Good day, how may I help you?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-banking-tutor.speaker: Banker tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-banking-tutor.text: This is the Lumbridge branch of the Bank of Gielinor! Would you like to access your account?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-banking-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-banking-tutor.text: I don't have an account! All my belongings are safe at home in Dorgesh-Kaan!

options.text: How do I use the bank?

steps.player: Using the bank itself. I'm not sure how....?

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: Speak to any banker and ask to see your bank account. If you have set a PIN you will be asked for it, then all the belongings you have placed in the bank will appear in the window. To withdraw one item, left-

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: click on it once.

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: To withdraw many, right-click on the item and select from the menu. The same for depositing, left-click on the item in your inventory to deposit it in the bank. Right-click on it to deposit many of the same items.

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: To move things around in your bank: firstly select Swap or Insert as your default moving mode, you can find these buttons on the bank window itself. Then click and drag an item to where you want it to appear.

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: You may withdraw 'notes' or 'certificates' when the items you are trying to withdraw do not stack in your inventory. This will only work for items which are tradable.

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: For instance, if you wanted to sell 100 logs to another player, they would not fit in one inventory and you would need to do multiple trades. Instead, click the Note button to do withdraw the logs as 'certs' or 'notes',

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: then withdraw the items you need.

steps.player: Using Bank deposit boxes.... what are they?

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: They look like grey pillars, there's one just over there, near the desk. Bank deposit boxes save so much time. If you're simply wanting to deposit a single item, 'Use' it on the deposit box.

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: Otherwise, simply click once on the box and it will give you a choice of what to deposit in an interface very similar to the bank itself. Very quick for when you're simply fishing or mining etc.

options.text: What's this PIN thing that people keep talking about?

steps.player: What's this PIN thing that people keep talking about?

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: The PIN - Personal Identification Number - can be set on your bank account to protect the items there in case someone finds out your account password. It consists of four numbers that you remember and tell

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: no one.

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: So if someone did manage to get your password they couldn't steal your items if they were in the bank.

options.text: How do I set my PIN?

steps.player: How do I set my PIN?

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: You can set your PIN by talking to any banker, they will allow you to access your bank pin settings. Here you can choose to set your pin and recovery delay. Remember not to set it to anything personal such as

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: your real life bank PIN or birthday.

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: The recovery delay is to protect your banked items from account thieves. If someone stole your account and asked to have the PIN deleted, they would have to wait a few days before accessing your bank account to

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: steal your items. This will give you time to recover your account.

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: There will also be a delay in actually setting the PIN to be used, this is so that if your account is stolen and a PIN set, you can cancel it before it comes into use!

options.text: How do I remove my PIN?

steps.player: How do I remove my PIN?

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: Talking to any banker will enable you to access your PIN settings. There you can cancel or change your PIN, but you will need to wait for your recovery delay to expire to be able to access your bank. This

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: can be set in the settings page and will protect your items should your account be stolen.

options.text: What happens if I forget my PIN?

steps.player: What happens if I forget my PIN?

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: If you find yourself faced with the PIN keypad and you don't know the PIN, just look on the right-hand side for a button marked 'I don't know it'. Click this button. Your PIN will be deleted (after a delay of a

steps.speaker: Banker tutor
steps.text: few days) and you'll be able to use your bank as before. You may still use the bank deposit box without your PIN.

options.text: I know about the PIN, tell me about the bank.
I'd like to access my bank account please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to buy more bank slots.

steps.player: I'd like to buy more bank slots.

steps.speaker: Banker
steps.text: I can sell you up to [number] additional bank slots in sets of 40. How many are you interested in buying?
Bank space purchase interface opens.

steps.speaker: Banker
steps.text: Buying [number] additional bank slots will cost [number] coins. Be warned, this purchase is not reversible. Are you happy to proceed?

steps.speaker: Banker
steps.text: Your additional bank slots have been added.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-hans.speaker: Hans
a-tour-of-lumbridge-hans.text: Hello. What are you doing here?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-hans.player: I'm giving Zanik here a tour of Lumbridge.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-hans.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-hans.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-hans.speaker: Hans
a-tour-of-lumbridge-hans.text: Pleased to meet you, Zanik! I know not everyone in Lumbridge was pleased with the peace treaty, but I'm delighted to have new underground neighbours.

options.text: I'm looking for whoever is in charge of this place.

steps.player: I'm looking for whoever is in charge of this place.

steps.speaker: Hans
steps.text: Who, the Duke? He's in his study, on the first floor.

options.text: I have come to kill everyone in this castle!

steps.player: I have come to kill everyone in this castle!

steps.text: Hans runs away from the player screaming

steps.speaker: Hans
steps.text: Help! Help!

options.text: I don't know. I'm lost. Where am I?

steps.player: I don't know. I'm lost. Where am I?

steps.speaker: Hans
steps.text: You are in Lumbridge Castle, in the Kingdom of Misthalin. Across the river, the road leads north to Varrock, and to the west lies Draynor Village.

options.text: Can you tell me how long I've been here?

steps.player: Can you tell me how long I've been here?

steps.speaker: Hans
steps.text: Ahh, I see all the newcomers arriving in Lumbridge, fresh-faced and eager for adventure. I remember you...

steps.speaker: Hans
steps.text: You've spent [amount] days, [amount] hours, [amount] minutes in the world since you arrived [amount] days ago.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-gee-or-donie.speaker: Gee/Donie
a-tour-of-lumbridge-gee-or-donie.text: Hello there, can I help you?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-gee-or-donie.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-gee-or-donie.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-gee-or-donie.player: I'm taking Zanik on a tour of Lumbridge. She's the first cave goblin to visit the surface!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-gee-or-donie.speaker: Gee/Donie
a-tour-of-lumbridge-gee-or-donie.text: Hello Zanik! I hope you like what you find up here!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-gee-or-donie.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-gee-or-donie.text: It's amazing! The sky is so huge!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-gee-or-donie.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-gee-or-donie.text: But I'm not sure I'd want to live under it for too long. It's kind of scary!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-lumbridge-guide.speaker: Lumbridge Guide
a-tour-of-lumbridge-lumbridge-guide.text: Greetings adventurer. I am Phileas the Lumbridge Guide.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-lumbridge-guide.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-lumbridge-guide.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-lumbridge-guide.speaker: Lumbridge Guide
a-tour-of-lumbridge-lumbridge-guide.text: Greetings Zanik! I am here to give information and directions to new players. Do you require any help?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-lumbridge-guide.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-lumbridge-guide.text: No thank you! [player name] is showing me around!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-lumbridge-guide.speaker: Lumbridge Guide
a-tour-of-lumbridge-lumbridge-guide.text: Well, can I help you, [player name]?

options.text: No, I can find things myself thank you.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cooking-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-cooking-tutor.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cooking-tutor.speaker: Cooking tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-cooking-tutor.text: Hello there Zanik! How can I help?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cooking-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-cooking-tutor.text: What kind of foods do you eat up here on the surface?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cooking-tutor.speaker: Cooking tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-cooking-tutor.text: All sorts of foods! There are lots of kinds of fish, and there are stews, pizzas, bread, baked potatoes...

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cooking-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-cooking-tutor.text: This is so exciting! Perhaps later I'll come back and sample lots of different surface foods!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-cooking-tutor.speaker: Cooking tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-cooking-tutor.text: I'm sure you'll like them! What about you, [player name]? Can I help you?

options.text: How can I train my cooking?
What kinds of things can I cook?

steps.speaker: Cooking tutor
steps.text: Well, just come back any time you want to know how to cook up a storm!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-bob.speaker: Bob
a-tour-of-lumbridge-bob.text: Get out of my shop! GET OUT!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-bob.speaker: Bob
a-tour-of-lumbridge-bob.text: We don't serve the likes of that thing in here.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-bob.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-bob.text: I don't need anything you've got to sell anyway!

steps.speaker: Bob
steps.text: And don't come back, you filthy goblin!

steps.speaker: Bob
steps.text: Oh, well... what do you want?

steps.speaker: Bob
steps.text: Get yer own!

steps.speaker: Bob
steps.text: Yes! I buy and sell axes! Take your pick (or axe)!

options.text: Can you repair my items for me?

steps.player: Can you repair my items for me?

steps.speaker: Bob
steps.text: Of course I'll repair it, though the materials may cost you. Just hand me the item and I'll have a look.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-aereck.speaker: Father Aereck
a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-aereck.text: Welcome to the church of Holy Saradomin!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-aereck.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-aereck.text: What's a church? And what is Holy Saradomin?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-aereck.speaker: Father Aereck
a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-aereck.text: Surely you have heard of the god, Saradomin?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-aereck.speaker: Father Aereck
a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-aereck.text: He who creates the forces of goodness and purity in this world? I cannot believe your ignorance!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-aereck.speaker: Father Aereck
a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-aereck.text: Not just A god! Saradomin is the god with more followers than any other! At least in this part of the world.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-aereck.speaker: Father Aereck
a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-aereck.text: Which god do you cave goblins worship?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-aereck.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-aereck.text: Thousands of years ago the gods made our ancestors fight in horrible wars. It was only after we escaped from them that we were able to build a civilisation.

options.text: What god did the Dorgeshuun use to follow?

steps.player: What god did the Dorgeshuun use to follow?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Our history does not remember his name. We know only that he was a violent god of war.

steps.speaker: Father Aereck
steps.text: Sounds like Zamorak to me! Or one of the minor gods who followed him.

steps.speaker: Father Aereck
steps.text: Saradomin would never be so barbaric.

steps.speaker: Father Aereck
steps.text: We do have stories about a war between the gods. I had always interpreted them as symbolic of the spiritual war between light and darkness in our hearts.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Dorgeshuun history remembers them as real. But we don't know much detail. Our ancestors were just footsoldiers, they didn't know what they were fighting for.

steps.speaker: Father Aereck
steps.text: I am sure they were engaged in a noble struggle, although perhaps on the wrong side!

steps.speaker: Father Aereck
steps.text: Saradomin was fighting to bring goodness and order to the universe, but Zamorak was leading the forces of darkness in a bid to bring eternal night to the world!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Our history doesn't make a distinction. There was your own god who would kill you if you refused to fight, and someone else's god who would only kill you if you lost.

options.text: Not all the gods are bad!

steps.player: Not all the gods are bad!

steps.speaker: Father Aereck
steps.text: Quite right! The Dorgeshuun have just had bad experiences of them.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Maybe that's true. I should try to approach things with an open mind!

steps.speaker: Father Aereck
steps.text: Exactly! You Dorgeshuun have lived in darkness for too long. But now you can come into the light of Holy Saradomin!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: We don't like bright lights. They hurt our eyes.

steps.speaker: Father Aereck
steps.text: May Saradomin bless you in all your pursuits!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I can manage without Saradomin, but thanks anyway.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-woodsman-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-woodsman-tutor.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-woodsman-tutor.speaker: Woodsman tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-woodsman-tutor.text: Greetings, Zanik! Listen to the wind in the trees...

a-tour-of-lumbridge-woodsman-tutor.speaker: Woodsman tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-woodsman-tutor.text: Of course! What did you think they were?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-woodsman-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-woodsman-tutor.text: I don't know! I've never visited the surface before!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-woodsman-tutor.speaker: Woodsman tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-woodsman-tutor.text: Shall I show you how to chop trees and make fires then?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-woodsman-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-woodsman-tutor.text: Perhaps some other time. Right now I'm just looking around.

options.text: Any advice for an advanced woodcutter?

steps.text: If the player is not carrying an axe:
If the player's inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Woodsman tutor
steps.text: I'd give you an axe to chop trees with but you don't have room in your inventory.

steps.speaker: Woodsman tutor
steps.text: As you're already here, have an axe so that you can chop the trees around me.
bronze axe

steps.speaker: Woodsman tutor
steps.text: As you get better and better you'll find that you can chop trees such as Maple and Yew! These are very good for firemaking.

steps.speaker: Woodsman tutor
steps.text: Of course, they're also very useful for fletching.

steps.speaker: Woodsman tutor
steps.text: Also, look out for birds' nests, you never know what our feathered friends have been collecting. Jewellery and Clue scrolls maybe?

options.text: Tell me about different trees and axes.

steps.player: Tell me about different trees and axes.

steps.text: Almost every tree can be chopped down. Normal logs will be produced by chopping 'Trees' and Oak logs will come from chopping 'Oak Trees'. You can find Oak trees in amongst normal trees scattered about the lands.
Willow trees will yield willow logs. You'll find willows like to grow near water, you can find some south of Draynor.
Maple logs can be gleaned from Maple trees. You'll usually find Maple trees standing alone amongst other trees.
Yew trees are few and far between. We do our best to cultivate them. Look for the tree icon on your minimap to find rare trees. Try North of Port Sarim.

options.condition: If the player has level 29-98 Woodcutting

steps.text: Magic trees are... magic. A difficult wood to work with, but worth it for the rewards. Find them in the areas south of Seers village or on the East side of the Mage Arena.

steps.speaker: Woodsman tutor
steps.text: Hollow trees can be found in the Haunted Woods east of Canifis, but be careful of the leeches.
Bronze axes are easy to get, simply go visit Bob in his shop in Lumbridge, or talk to me if you have mislaid yours.

steps.speaker: Woodsman tutor
steps.text: As you progress in your combat skill you will find you can wield your woodcutting axe as a weapon, it's not very effective, but it frees up a slot for another log.
As your woodcutting skill increases you will find yourself able to use better axes to chop trees faster.... anything up to steel you can buy from Bob's axe shop.
Rune axes can be player made with very high level smithing and mining. They can also be obtained through killing one of the fearsome tree spirits, though this is very rare.

options.text: What is that cape you're wearing?

steps.player: What is that cape you're wearing?

steps.speaker: Woodsman tutor
steps.text: This is a Skillcape of Woodcutting, wearing one increases your chance of finding bird's nests. Only a person who has achieved the highest possible level in a skill can wear one.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-smithing-apprentice.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-smithing-apprentice.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-smithing-apprentice.speaker: Smithing apprentice
a-tour-of-lumbridge-smithing-apprentice.text: Hello there, Zanik! You look like you know your ores!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-smithing-apprentice.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-smithing-apprentice.text: Well, I know iron and silver. What other ores are there?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-smithing-apprentice.speaker: Smithing apprentice
a-tour-of-lumbridge-smithing-apprentice.text: There are all sorts! Mithril, adamantite, runite... shall I tell you about them?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-smithing-apprentice.player: What do I do after smelting the ore?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-smithing-apprentice.speaker: Smithing apprentice
a-tour-of-lumbridge-smithing-apprentice.text: Ahh you'll need to learn to smith. You can use bronze bars on the anvil outside with a hammer.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-smithing-apprentice.speaker: Smithing apprentice
a-tour-of-lumbridge-smithing-apprentice.text: But for the best advice, go to Varrock. That's where my master, the Smithing Tutor, plies his trade. Ask him to teach you how to smith.
Look for this icon in the west of Varrock.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-smithing-apprentice.speaker: Smithing apprentice
a-tour-of-lumbridge-smithing-apprentice.text: Smelt some ore and store it in the bank. Grab a hammer from the general store before you go too!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-ranged-combat-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-ranged-combat-tutor.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-ranged-combat-tutor.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-ranged-combat-tutor.text: Hi, Zanik! I see you know how to handle a bow!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-ranged-combat-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-ranged-combat-tutor.text: They tell me I'm an expert with the bone crossbow!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-ranged-combat-tutor.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-ranged-combat-tutor.text: You don't need any more help, then. How about you, [player name]?

options.text: How can I train my Ranged?

steps.player: How can I train my Ranged?

steps.text: If the player's Ranged level is below X {{tmissing}} :

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: To start with you'll need a bow and arrows, you were given a Shortbow and some arrows when you arrived here from Tutorial island.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: Alternatively, you can claim a training bow and some arrows from me.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: Mikasi, the Magic Combat tutor and I both give out items every 30 minutes, however you must choose whether you want runes or ranged equipment.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: To claim the Training bow and arrows, right-click on me and choose Claim, to claim runes right-click on the Magic Combat tutor and select Claim.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: Not all bows can use every type of arrow, most bows have a limit. You can find out your bows limit by checking the Ranged skill guide.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: If you do decide to use the Training bow, you will only be able to use the Training arrows with it. Remember to pick up your arrows, re-use them and come back when you need more.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: Once you have your bow and arrows, equip them by selecting their Wield option in your inventory.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: You can change the way you attack by going to the combat options tab. There are three attack styles for bows. Those styles are Accurate, Rapid and Longrange.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: Accurate increases your bows attack accuracy. Rapid will increase your attack speed with the bow. Longrange will let you attack your enemies from a greater distance.
If the player is eligible for Adventure paths:

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: If you need some more advice, you should talk to Adventurer Jon about Adventure paths. He may even have a handy starter kit you can use.
If the player's Ranged level is above Y {{tmissing}}:

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: My word, I think you should be the one giving me advice instead, but I will do my best.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: You should know the basics of ranged combat by now, but if you are looking for somewhere to test your skills and make some money, you should try hunting Moss giants in Varrock sewers.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: If you are lucky you might find a Mossy key, with this key you will be able to enter Bryophyta's lair. Make sure to bring plenty of food and good armour and weapons when you fight her as you will need it.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: If your lucky you might snag some goodies that you can sell for a decent profit.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: If you are looking to do something different, visit the ranging guild over near Hemenster, there you can practice your archery and earn tickets for it at the same time.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: You can then hand those tickets in for a variety of goods you can use to train your Ranged skill.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: If you are ever in the market for a new bow or some arrows, you should head on over to Lowe's Archery Emporium in Varrock. I can show you where the shop is if you like.
The world map opens and pans to the location of Lowe's Archery Emporium.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you want to know?

options.text: How do I create a bow and arrows?

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: Ahh the art of fletching. Fletching is used to create your own bow and arrows.
If the player is on a free-to-play world:

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: To create your bow and arrows you would need to gather some wood, feathers, arrow heads and bow string. The wood would be to make arrow shafts which can be turned into unstrung bows and arrow shafts.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: Unfortunately, Fletching is a member only skill so you will have to get your ranging supplies from shops or other players.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you want to know?
If the player is on a members' world:

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: It's quite simple really. You'll need an axe to cut some logs from trees and a knife. Knives can be found in and around the Lumbridge castle and in the Varrock General store upstairs.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: Use your knife on the logs. This will bring up a menu listing items you can fletch.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: For arrows you will need to smith some arrow heads and kill some chickens for feathers.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: Add the feathers to your Arrow shafts to make Headless arrows, then use your chosen arrow heads on the Headless arrows to make your arrows.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: Now for making bows. When accessing the fletching menu, instead of choosing Arrows shafts, you can make an unstrung bow instead.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: To complete the bow you will need to get your hands on a Bow string.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: First you will need to get some flax from a flax field. There's one south of Seers' Village. Gather flax, then spin it on a spinning wheel, there's one in Seers' Village too.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: This makes bow strings which you can then use on the unstrung bows to make a working bow!

steps.player: Brilliant. If I forget anything I'll come talk to you again.

steps.speaker: Ranged combat tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you want to know?

options.text: Let's discuss how my ammo acts when I pick it up.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-magic-combat-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-magic-combat-tutor.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-magic-combat-tutor.speaker: Magic combat tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-magic-combat-tutor.text: Greetings Zanik! You look like someone who might know something about spells!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-magic-combat-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-magic-combat-tutor.text: Actually I don't know anything about spells.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-magic-combat-tutor.speaker: Magic combat tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-magic-combat-tutor.text: Well, if you have some air runes and mind runes you can cast Wind Strike...

a-tour-of-lumbridge-magic-combat-tutor.speaker: Magic combat tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-magic-combat-tutor.text: You can't even cast Wind Strike?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-magic-combat-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-magic-combat-tutor.text: We Dorgeshuun don't have any magical knowledge at all.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-magic-combat-tutor.speaker: Magic combat tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-magic-combat-tutor.text: Well, if you don't know the basics at all it'll take a long time to teach you...

a-tour-of-lumbridge-magic-combat-tutor.speaker: Magic combat tutor

a-tour-of-lumbridge-melee-combat-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-melee-combat-tutor.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-melee-combat-tutor.speaker: Melee combat tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-melee-combat-tutor.text: Ho there Zanik! You look like a strong fighter!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-melee-combat-tutor.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-melee-combat-tutor.text: I've been training on giant frogs!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-melee-combat-tutor.speaker: Melee combat tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-melee-combat-tutor.text: You don't need any more help, then. How about you, [player name]?

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: Well adventurer, the first thing you will need is a sword and a shield appropriate for your level.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: Make sure to equip your sword and shield. Click on them in your inventory, they will disappear from your inventory and move to your worn items. You can see your worn items in the worn items tab here.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: When you are wielding your sword you will then be able to see the correct options in the combat interface.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: There are four different melee styles. Accurate, aggressive, defensive and controlled. Not all weapons will have all four styles though.

steps.player: Interesting, what does each style do?

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: Well I am glad you asked. The accurate style will give you experience points in your Attack skill, you will also find you will deal damage more frequently as a result of being, well, more accurate.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: Next we have the aggressive style. This style will give you experience points in your Strength skill. When using this style you will notice that your attacks will hit a little harder.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: Now for the defensive style, this style will give you experience points in your Defensive skill. When using this style you will notice that you get hit less often.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: Finally, we have the controlled style. This style will give you the same amount of experience as the other styles would but shared across all three of the combat skills.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: If you were using the training sword for example, there are four different attack types. Stab, lunge, slash and block.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: Each type uses one of the attack styles. Stab uses accurate, lunge and slash use aggressive and block uses defensive.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: To find out which style an attack type uses, hover your mouse cursor over the style button.
If the player is eligible for Adventure paths:

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: If you need some more advice, you should talk to Adventurer Jon about Adventure paths. He may even have a handy starter kit you can use.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you would like to know?

options.text: What if I wanted to fight something a bit more... human.

steps.player: What if I wanted to fight something a bit more... human.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: Well adventurer, there are a few places you might be able to do this.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: You could try your luck at castle wars. Here, two teams fight each other to defend their respective flags. To win the game you will need to get the other team's flag and return it to your flag stand.

steps.player: Capture the flag, sounds like a lot of fun.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: If you are in a clan, you should gather some clan members and try out clan wars. There you can see which clan is better than the other by fighting each other in an arena.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: Both activities are safe minigame, which means if you die you will not loose any of your items. You can get to them by using the teleport option in your minigames tab.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: There is also the wilderness. The wilderness is north of Varrock and you can fight other players there. But bare in mind if you die to another player in the wilderness you will lose your stuff.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: But this also means that if you kill another player you will be able to take their stuff too.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: Only go into the wilderness with items you are willing to lose and pay attention to the wilderness level you are in. The higher the level you go, more player will be able to attack you.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: You can find which player can attack you by checking your combat level.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: Minus the wilderness level from your combat level to find the lowest level that you can attack, then add the wilderness level to your combat level to find the highest level that you can attack.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you would like to know?

options.text: Tell me about different weapon types I can use.
I'd like a training sword and shield.
Tell me about different weapon types I can use.

steps.player: Tell me about different weapon types I can use

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: Well let me see now...There are stabbing type weapons such as daggers, then you have swords which are slashing, maces that have great crushing abilities, battle axes which are powerful.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: It depends a lot on how you want to fight. Experiment and find out what is best for you. Never be scared to try out a new weapon; you never know, you might like it!

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: While I tried all of them for a while, I settled on this rather good sword.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: You might also find that different weapon types are more accurate against different monsters.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you would like to know?

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: Of course. Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.

steps.speaker: Melee combat tutor
steps.text: The Cape of Defence will act as ring of life, saving you from combat if your hitpoints become low.

steps.text: Is there anything else you would like to know?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-prayer-tutor.speaker: Prayer tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-prayer-tutor.text: Greetings, Zanik! Dedication's what you need.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-prayer-tutor.speaker: Prayer tutor
a-tour-of-lumbridge-prayer-tutor.text: Because training your prayer takes a long time!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-prayer-tutor.text: I don't want to train prayer! I can manage without asking the gods for favours!

options.text: How can I train my prayer?

steps.player: How can I train my prayer?

steps.text: If the player has 99 prayer:

steps.speaker: Prayer tutor
steps.text: I think you should be teaching me a thing or two, shouldn't you?

steps.speaker: Prayer tutor
steps.text: Well, if you really want my advice...

steps.speaker: Prayer tutor
steps.text: The most common way to train prayer is by either burying bones, or offering them to the gods at some kind of an altar.

steps.speaker: Prayer tutor
steps.text: Lots of adventurers build such altars in their own homes, or there are a few frequent places of worship around the world.

steps.speaker: Prayer tutor
steps.text: Different kinds of bones will help you to train faster. Generally speaking, the bigger they are and the more frightening a creature they come from, the better they are for it.

steps.speaker: Prayer tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you would like to know?

steps.speaker: Prayer tutor
steps.text: The gods look kindly upon their devout followers. There are all kinds of benefits they may provide, if you pray for them!

steps.speaker: Prayer tutor
steps.text: They could help you in combat, help your wounds to heal more quickly, protect your belongings... There's a lot they can do for you!
The prayer tab opens.

steps.speaker: Prayer tutor
steps.text: You can find out more by looking in your prayer book.

steps.speaker: Prayer tutor
steps.text: You need to be careful that your prayers don't run out, though. You can get prayer potions to help you recharge, or you can pray at an altar whenever one's nearby.

steps.speaker: Prayer tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you would like to know?

steps.speaker: Prayer tutor
steps.text: Very well. Saradomin be with you!

steps.speaker: Mining tutor
steps.text: Ok then.. here goes....
Clay can be mined in many places. Try south west of Varrock or the crafting guild. See the crafting tutor upstairs in Lumbridge Castle for more information on what you can make with clay.
Rune Essence can only be mined at secret places... I don't know where these are but you can speak to the Duke of Lumbridge to find out more.

steps.speaker: Mining tutor
steps.text: You can make all sorts of things from clay, if you have the crafting skill. Rune Essence is used for magic to cast spells.
Rocks which yield copper ore can be found around here, and other places such as Al Kharid, Rimmington or Varrock mines. They're quite common.
Tin ore is much the same as copper. It can be found around this area as well as Varrock, Al Kharid and the Barbarian Village.
Iron can be mined around Rimmington, Al Kharid and Varrock. It's tricky to smelt though - see the boy at the furnace in Lumbridge for tips.
Look for this icon on your minimap to find the furnace.
You'll need to be a fairly good miner before you can start mining coal. You can find it in the Dwarf mine, Al Kharid and quite a few other places.
Silver can be mined to help you with your crafting. You can find it in the Crafting guild, Al Kharid and many other mines.
Gold requires quite a lot of experience in mining before you can successfully extract it from the rocks. It can be found in Al Kharid, the Crafting guild, Rimmington and other places.
Mithril and Adamantite rocks are fairly rare and require great skill to mine. You can find them in Al Kharid, the Dwarven mines, Lumbridge Swamps and other places.
Runite is the most prized of ores and is very rare. I'll leave you to find where to mine it.

The Bronze Pick is your basic tool of the trade. You can buy one from Bob's Axe shop very cheaply, that's north of here in Lumbridge, I also heard that exploring the castle walls may yield a surprise or two.
The Iron and Steel Picks are faster than the bronze pickaxe, but you will need to progress with your mining a little before you can use them. You can buy them from Nurmof in the Dwarven mines.
Mithril, Adamantite, and Rune Picks may be used as you progress with your skill of mining. They can be obtained from Nurmof in the Dwarven mines.
