options.text: I already know about the basics of fishing, got any tips?
options.condition: If the player has level 29-38 Fishing:

steps.player: I already know about the basics of fishing, got any tips?

steps.text: If the player has inventory space and no small fishing net:
If the player is holding a small fishing net:

steps.speaker: Fishing tutor
steps.text: Arrr, chose carefully where and what you fish, you can get different fish in different places throughout the land.

steps.speaker: Fishing tutor
steps.text: Make sure you hang on to your fish, don't throw them away as you can get valuable cooking experience from them, gar! Look out for other things too...
If the player is on a members world:

steps.speaker: Fishing tutor
steps.text: Then of course there is always the trawler...

steps.speaker: Fishing tutor
steps.text: If you venture to Port Khazard north of Yanille and speaks to me cabin boy Murphy, he can let you and a bunch of friends use his trawler to fish with... Just make sure you take a bailing bucket or two.

steps.speaker: Fishing tutor
steps.text: I can show ye on that map of yours if ya like?
(Map opens.)

options.text: Any advice for an advanced fisher?
options.condition: If the player has level 39-99 Fishing:

steps.player: Any advice for an advanced fisher?

steps.text: If the player has inventory space and no small fishing net:
If the player is holding a small fishing net:

steps.speaker: Fishing tutor
steps.text: Aye, as you get better and better you'll find that you can fish for things like Tuna and Swordfish. These be very good for combat.
If the player is on a members world:

steps.speaker: Fishing tutor
steps.text: Of course, after that you will get Shark, and if you venture out onto the Trawler from Port Khazard, you can then get Manta Ray or Sea Turtle, very good eatin' on one of them.

steps.speaker: Fishing tutor
steps.text: You can also use a fishing potion if you can get your hands on one and just need that little edge.. ask someone who is familiar with herblore.

steps.speaker: Fishing tutor
steps.text: Now.. quests...
If the player hasn't started Sea Slug:

steps.speaker: Fishing tutor
steps.text: Head over to south of the Legends Guild and East of Ardougne and find Caroline. This will have you investigating some strange happenings on the fishing platform.
Else if the player hasn't started Tai Bwo Wannai Trio:

steps.speaker: Fishing tutor
steps.text: Head over to Tai Bwo Wannai Village on the Isle of Karamja and speak to Timfraku to solve a strange mystery.
If the player was told about a quest:

steps.speaker: Fishing tutor
steps.text: I can show ye on that map of yours if ya like?
(Map opens.)
If the player had no quests available:

steps.speaker: Fishing tutor
steps.text: Can't rightly say's there's any I know of that you could handle at the moment, but come back when you're a bit more experienced and I'm sure I can give you a clue.

options.condition: If the player has level 1-38 fishing:

steps.text: Ahoy, small net fishin' you can do just south of Draynor Village and in these very spots here. Aye.
Shrimp and anchovies can be caught with your small fishin' net.

options.condition: If the player is on a members world:

steps.text: Aye, you can net yourself some big fish in Catherby, which is a good place to fish for most things, Gar!
Mackrel and Cod will form the backbone of your catch when big net fishin'.. except for the added extras...

steps.speaker: Fishing tutor
steps.text: Some rich rewards for big net fishin', make sure you be using a big net fishing spot though...

Aye, rod fishin' can be practiced here at these spots, as well as south of Draynor Village and in the Lumbridge river, depending upon your experience. You can get bait at any fishin' shop, there be one in Port Sarim.
With a rod you can catch pike, sardines and herring. Good eating on them.
The art of fly fishin' can be done in rivers, so the Lumbridge river here would suffice.
Aye, you can catch yourself a delicious trout or salmon.

options.condition: If the player has level 25 fishing:

steps.text: Arrr, Lobster pots can be used from the pier on the island of Karamja.
In Lobster pots you can catch lobsters. They're tasty after thems cooked.

options.condition: If the player has level 35 fishing:

steps.text: Arrr, you can also use your harpoon from the pier on the island of Karamja.
With it you can catch Tuna and Swordfish.
If the player is on a members world:
... and shark.

steps.speaker: Fishing tutor
steps.text: Ahoy, there's also the fishin' guild if ya skilled enough, you can find it south west of Seers' Village.

options.text: Where and what should I fix?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-shop-keeper-assistan.speaker: Shop keeper
a-tour-of-lumbridge-shop-keeper-assistan.text: Can I help you at all?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-shop-keeper-assistan.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-shop-keeper-assistan.text: It's a surface shop full of exotic surface goods! What are you selling?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-shop-keeper-assistan.speaker: Shop keeper
a-tour-of-lumbridge-shop-keeper-assistan.text: Um, yes, exotic surface goods... here, have a look at our wares...

a-tour-of-lumbridge-shop-keeper-assistan.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-shop-keeper-assistan.text: Wow... The bucket and the hammer, what are they made of?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-shop-keeper-assistan.speaker: Shop keeper
a-tour-of-lumbridge-shop-keeper-assistan.text: Um... wood. It, er, grows on trees?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-shop-keeper-assistan.speaker: Shop keeper
a-tour-of-lumbridge-shop-keeper-assistan.text: So, do you want to buy anything?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-shop-keeper-assistan.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-shop-keeper-assistan.text: A wood bucket! And a wood hammer! And a newcomer map! I brought some surface money.

options.text: Yes please. What are you selling?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-near-the-gob.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-near-the-gob.text: Yes! The Dorgeshuun tribe? We live underground. We've been cut off from other goblins for generations but now we're back!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-near-the-gob.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-near-the-gob.text: We, er, we're your distant cousins? We want to learn about your culture.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-near-the-gob.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-near-the-gob.text: Your art! Your philosophy! Your way of life! Now that the godwars are over you must have been able to build a peaceful civilisation!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-near-the-gob.speaker: Goblin
a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-near-the-gob.text: Peace is for weak. We goblins! We strong!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-near-the-gob.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-near-the-gob.text: Why is peace for the weak?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-near-the-gob.speaker: Goblin
a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-near-the-gob.text: Big High War God say so! He make us strong!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-border-guard.player: Can we come through this gate?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-border-guard.speaker: Border Guard
a-tour-of-lumbridge-border-guard.text: You may pass if you pay the toll, but your goblin friend must stay on this side.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-border-guard.speaker: Border Guard
a-tour-of-lumbridge-border-guard.text: Why do you think this gate is here, if not to keep the goblins out of Al Kharid?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-border-guard.player: But Zanik isn't like other goblins!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-border-guard.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-border-guard.text: Never mind, [player name]. I don't think we need to go to Al Kharid anyway!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-fred-the-farmer.speaker: Fred the Farmer
a-tour-of-lumbridge-fred-the-farmer.text: What are you doing on my land?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-fred-the-farmer.speaker: Fred the Farmer
a-tour-of-lumbridge-fred-the-farmer.text: Yes, my land! This is my farm!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-fred-the-farmer.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-fred-the-farmer.text: I'm sorry! I didn't realize. I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-fred-the-farmer.speaker: Fred the Farmer
a-tour-of-lumbridge-fred-the-farmer.text: So you're one of them cave goblins, then? I suppose you weren't to know.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-fred-the-farmer.speaker: Fred the Farmer
a-tour-of-lumbridge-fred-the-farmer.text: Things? There's more than one now?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-fred-the-farmer.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-fred-the-farmer.text: There are lots of them! You know, the white fluffy things?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-fred-the-farmer.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-fred-the-farmer.text: 'Sheep'! Finding all these strange surface creatures is so exciting!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-fred-the-farmer.speaker: Fred the Farmer
a-tour-of-lumbridge-fred-the-farmer.text: What are you doing on my land?

options.text: I'm looking for something to kill.

steps.player: I'm looking for something to kill.

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: What, on my land? Leave my livestock alone you scoundrel!

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: How can you be lost? Just follow the road east and south. You'll end up in Lumbridge fairly quickly.

options.text: Fred! Fred! I've seen The Thing!

steps.player: Fred! Fred! I've seen The Thing!

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: You ... you actually saw it?

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Run for the hills! [player name] grab as many chickens as you can! We have to ...

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: ... flee! Oh, woe is me! The shapeshifter is coming! We're all ...

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: ... doomed. What!

steps.player: It's not a shapeshifter or any other kind of monster!

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Well then what is it?

steps.player: Well ... it's just two Penguins; Penguins disguised as a sheep.

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Have you been out in the sun too long?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-millie-miller.speaker: Millie Miller
a-tour-of-lumbridge-millie-miller.text: Hello Adventurers. Welcome to Mill Lane Mill. Can I help you?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-millie-miller.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-millie-miller.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! What is this place?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-millie-miller.speaker: Millie Miller
a-tour-of-lumbridge-millie-miller.text: This is Mill Lane Mill.  Millers of the finest flour in Gielinor, and home to the Miller family for many generations

a-tour-of-lumbridge-millie-miller.speaker: Millie Miller
a-tour-of-lumbridge-millie-miller.text: We take grain from the field nearby and mill into flour.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-millie-miller.speaker: Millie Miller
a-tour-of-lumbridge-millie-miller.text: It's the stuff we get from milling the grain. We use it to make bread and cakes and things.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-millie-miller.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-millie-miller.text: We don't have any of those things in Dorgesh-Kaan! They sound so interesting!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-urhney.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-urhney.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-urhney.speaker: Father Urhney
a-tour-of-lumbridge-father-urhney.text: I don't care! I'm still meditating!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-candle-seller.speaker: Candle seller
a-tour-of-lumbridge-candle-seller.text: Do you want a lit candle for 1000 gold?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-candle-seller.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-candle-seller.text: No thank you, I have a lantern of my own!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-candle-seller.speaker: Candle seller
a-tour-of-lumbridge-candle-seller.text: Oh! Who are you? Some kind of goblin?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-candle-seller.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-candle-seller.text: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-candle-seller.player: The Dorgeshuun live in the caves beneath the swamp. I made contact with them and now I'm giving Zanik a tour or the surface!

a-tour-of-lumbridge-candle-seller.speaker: Candle seller
a-tour-of-lumbridge-candle-seller.text: Oh, that's good! And it's all down to the candles I sold! So do you want to buy another one?

steps.text: If the player does not have 1000 coins:

steps.player: But I don't have that kind of money on me.

steps.speaker: Candle seller
steps.text: Well then, no candle for you!
If the player has at least 1000 coins:

steps.speaker: Candle seller
steps.text: Here you go then.

steps.speaker: Candle seller
steps.text: I should warn you, though, it can be dangerous to take a naked flame down there. You'd be better off making a lantern.

options.text: What's so dangerous about a naked flame?

steps.player: What's so dangerous about a naked flame?

steps.speaker: Candle seller
steps.text: Heh heh... You'll find out.

steps.speaker: Candle seller
steps.text: Look, you're not going to be able to survive down that hole without a light source.

steps.speaker: Candle seller
steps.text: So you could go off to the candle shop to buy one more cheaply. You could even make your own lantern, which is a lot better.

steps.speaker: Candle seller
steps.text: But I bet you want to find out what's down there right now, don't you? And you can pay me 1000 gold for the privilege!

options.text: All right, you win, I'll buy a candle.

steps.player: All right, you win, I'll buy a candle.

steps.speaker: Candle seller
steps.text: Out of glass.  The more advanced lanterns have a metal component as well.

steps.speaker: Candle seller
steps.text: Firstly you can make a simple candle lantern out of glass.  It's just like a candle, but the flame isn't exposed, so it's safer.

steps.speaker: Candle seller
steps.text: Then you can make an oil lamp, which is brighter but has an exposed flame.  But if you make an iron frame for it you can turn it into an oil lantern.

steps.speaker: Candle seller
steps.text: Finally there's the bullseye lantern.  You'll need to make a frame out of steel and add a glass lens.

steps.speaker: Candle seller
steps.text: Once you've made your lamp or lantern, you'll need to make lamp oil for it.  The chemist near Rimmington has a machine for that.

steps.speaker: Candle seller
steps.text: For any light source, you'll need a tinderbox to light it. Keep your tinderbox handy in case it goes out!

steps.speaker: Candle seller
steps.text: But if all that's too complicated, you can buy a candle right here for 1000 gold!

options.text: All right, you win, I'll buy a candle.

steps.player: All right, you win, I'll buy a candle.

options.text: No thanks, I'd rather curse the darkness.
No thanks, I'd rather curse the darkness.

steps.player: No thanks, I'd rather curse the darkness.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-mistag.speaker: Mistag
a-tour-of-lumbridge-mistag.text: Hello Zanik, hello [player name]. How is your exploration of the surface going?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-mistag.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-mistag.text: I've hardly SEEN the surface yet! [player name] just dragged me back down here!

options.text: Can I sell you some ore?
Why do the Dorgeshuun live underground?
Can you show me the way out of the mines?

a-tour-of-lumbridge-kazgar.speaker: Kazgar
a-tour-of-lumbridge-kazgar.text: Hello, Zanik! Hello, surface-dweller! Would you like me to lead you to the mines?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I ought to visit the Duke of Lumbridge while I'm here. Ur-Tag asked me to give him his regards.

options.text: Dialogue 2; after talking to the Duke

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Duke Horacio seemed nice. But politics is just as boring up here as it is at home!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: There are so many people around! You must introduce me to them, [player name]!

options.text: Dialogue 4; after introducing her to a common man or woman

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: It's a pity some people up here don't like me. I suppose I should have expected that.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: But at least you're friendly, [player name]!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Why don't you take me to a shop? I promised Tignik I would bring back a souvenir from the surface.

options.text: Dialogue 6; after taking her to a shop

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: This 'wood' is an odd material. It's heavier than bone but it doesn't seem to be as brittle. It would be good for making crossbows out of!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Are there still goblins living on the surface, [player name]? Are there any near Lumbridge?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I should reunite the two sides of the race!

options.text: Dialogue 8; after introducing her to a goblin

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Those poor goblins. It's hard to believe I'm the same species as them. No wonder the HAM people hate us if they assume we're like them.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: So far on the surface we haven't seen any... you know... gods.

steps.player: Of course not! The gods don't just wander around Lumbridge!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Don't they? I have no idea what to expect!

options.text: Dialogue 10; after introducing her to Father Aereck

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: That priest seemed friendly. I thought any servant of a god would be much more aggressive.

options.text: Dialogue 11; if you took her underground

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: What are we doing down here? I want to see the surface!

options.text: I need to do something else for a bit.
Have you seen enough of Lumbridge yet?

steps.player: Have you seen enough of Lumbridge yet?

steps.text: Before talking to the Duke:

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Perhaps we could talk to the Duke of Lumbridge. Headman Ur-Tag asked me to give him his regards.
Before talking to a common man/woman:

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: You must introduce me to some of the surface people!
Before talking to Father Aereck:

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Well... our legends all talk about the gods living on the surface, but since I've been up here I haven't see any. Is there anyone around here who might know about them?
Before talking to goblins:

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Are there still goblins living on the surface, Player? Are there any near Lumbridge?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I should reunite the two sides of the race!
Before talking to the shopkeeper:

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I promised Tignik I would bring a souvenir back from the surface. Will you take me to a shop?
After showing her everything she wanted to see:

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I think I've seen enough of Lumbridge now. If you like I'll tell you about the mark on my forehead.
A cutscene begins.
It was about the same time the passage to the surface opened up. I was visiting Juna, the Story-Snake. She likes to hear of my adventures and she sometimes lets me drink the Tears of Guthix.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: ...And when they opened up the giant frog's stomach they found all the missing silver, and Mistag's brooch!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Your stories have entertained me. I will let you into the cave for a short time.
I collected the tears like I had before...

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I hope I get ranging XP!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Aaaah!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: What -- what's happening?

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: It is not normal for the Tears to have that effect.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I know! What happened?

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: It is a sign. The power of the Tears has marked you for a special purpose.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I cannot tell you more now. That mark will soon fade, but someday it will glow again, and on that day you should return to me so that I can tell you more about your destiny.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Wow...
The cutscene ends.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Ever since then I've wondered what the sign meant. But perhaps you will help me to find out, [player name]!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I've seen enough of Lumbridge now. Let's get to the HAM lair and see if they're up to anything!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: You don't care about me at all!

options.text: Will you tell me about the mark on your forehead?

steps.player: Will you tell me about the mark on your forehead?

steps.text: If you're not done touring yet

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I, er...

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I will tell you, [player name], but not just yet. Finish showing me around Lumbridge and then I'll tell you.
If you are done touring, but outside Lumbridge

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: All right. But not here. Let's go back into Lumbridge town.

a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-too-far-from.speaker: Zanik
a-tour-of-lumbridge-walking-too-far-from.text: We're getting a bit far away from Lumbridge, [player name]. I'd like to see the rest of the world someday but not right now. Let's stick to Lumbridge for now.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: All right. I'll wait for you back in Lumbridge castle cellar.

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-zanik-withou.speaker: Zanik
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-zanik-withou.text: Aren't you going to put on your HAM disguise? You might be able to do without one but I don't want you giving me away!

options.text: I need to do something else for a bit.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: You'll have to find a new one from somewhere then.

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-zanik-while-.speaker: Zanik
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-zanik-while-.text: What are we waiting for? Let's get to the HAM hideout and find out what they're planning!

options.text: I need to do something else for a bit.

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-zanik-while-.speaker: Zanik
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-zanik-while-.text: Are you ready to go to the HAM cave now?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Well then, let's go!

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.speaker: H.A.M. Guard
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.text: Hello, brother, you fit in much better now that you're correctly attired. Before you stuck out like a sore thumb! Keep your eyes peeled though; I've heard there are thieves amongst us!

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.speaker: H.A.M. Guard
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.text: I don't think I've seen you before! What's your name?

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.speaker: H.A.M. Guard
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.text: Zanik? What kind of a name is that?

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.speaker: H.A.M. Guard
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.text: It's good that we're getting members from further afield!

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.speaker: H.A.M. Guard
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.text: Is the monster problem very bad where you're from, Zanik?

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.speaker: Zanik
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.text: Oh yes. My whole city is overrun by goblins.

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.speaker: H.A.M. Guard
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.text: You know, there are goblins living right underneath Lumbridge. And the duke is treating them as if they were people like you and me! He's even signed a peace treaty with them!

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.speaker: Zanik
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.text: So what's your group planning to do about it?

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.speaker: H.A.M. Guard
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.text: Johanhus doesn't tell his plans to ordinary members like us, but I've heard he and Sigmund are planning something big.

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.speaker: H.A.M. Guard
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.text: I don't think we'll have to worry about the cave goblin threat for much longer!

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.speaker: Zanik
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-ham-guard-ne.text: No... I'm sure the threat will be dealt with soon.

options.text: What are all you people doing here?
Who are you and what do you do here?
What do you think you're going to achieve?
Where did all you people come from?

ham-infiltrators-walking-near-the-ham-de.speaker: Zanik
ham-infiltrators-walking-near-the-ham-de.text: Listen to what that speaker's saying, [player name]!

ham-infiltrators-walking-near-the-ham-de.speaker: Zanik
ham-infiltrators-walking-near-the-ham-de.text: And they're all lapping it up! No one challenges him or even asks questions. They're just sitting there while he fills their minds with hate!

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-sigmund.speaker: Sigmund
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-sigmund.text: So you've brought a friend down here to mock me, [player name]? Well soon I will be the one mocking you!

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-sigmund.speaker: Zanik
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-sigmund.text: Is that Sigmund? The one who tried to start the war between Lumbridge and the cave goblins?

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-sigmund.speaker: Sigmund
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-sigmund.text: Yes, I am! And I'm not ashamed of it! Those cave goblins are an abomination in the eyes of Holy Saradomin!

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-sigmund.speaker: Sigmund
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-sigmund.text: But I have another plan to destroy them. Soon Johanhus and I will be meeting to discuss the details.

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-sigmund.speaker: Sigmund
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-sigmund.text: And there's nothing you can do about it!

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-johanhus-uls.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-johanhus-uls.text: Welcome brother... to our organisation... Ours is a fight for humanity in all its shapes and forms... and to rid mankind of the monsters that exist in our world.

options.text: What kind of organisation is this?

steps.player: What kind of organisation is this?

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: We're a proactive organisation working towards the cessation of monsters in normal civilised human society. There seems to be no backbone in this land so we're stepping up to the challenge.

steps.player: Hmm, how do you propose to do that? I mean, I see people everyday killing goblins around here!

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: We're mobilising people and we're starting our own society...cleaning out the caves once inhabited by these foul creatures and defending them so that they can never again shelter sub human species.

steps.player: That sounds kind of strange, but hey it's your choice.

options.text: Who are you and what do you do here?

steps.player: Who are you and what do you do here?

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: My name is Johanhus and I lead these glorious people on a courageous mission called, 'Humans against Monsters', we mean to make this land free of monsters so we can all live in peace.

options.text: Are you planning to do anything about the cave goblins?

steps.player: Are you planning to do anything about the cave goblins?

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: You should know, brother... we don't let ordinary members in on all our plans... but rest assured those foul creatures will be dealt with very soon!

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: No! That kind of information is for...only senior members of the group. Ordinary members like you must learn to...trust your leaders.

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: How can you even...ask that? Right beneath Lumbridge is a whole cave system full of those creatures! They've got a passage leading right up into the castle kitchen!

steps.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
steps.text: And I've heard that there's a whole city of those things down there, not that anyone has ever seen it. What have they got in there? What are they planning?

ham-infiltrators-talking-to-zanik-withou.speaker: Zanik
ham-infiltrators-talking-to-zanik-withou.text: So this is the HAM hideout. It's so squalid and dirty! I don't know how they can bear to live here.

options.text: I need to do something else for a bit.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: We ought to talk to some of the HAM people. That's what we're here for, after all!

ham-infiltrators-after-talking-to-hams.speaker: Zanik
ham-infiltrators-after-talking-to-hams.text: Let's have another look around the main area. Maybe there's something we missed.

options.text: I need to do something else for a bit.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Not yet. There must be another area where the HAM people make their plans. We should try to find it.

ham-infiltrators-walking-near-the-rubble.speaker: Zanik
ham-infiltrators-walking-near-the-rubble.text: Over there. There's a trapdoor hidden by dirt.

ham-infiltrators-walking-near-the-rubble.player: You cave goblins must have better eyesight than humans. I would never have noticed it without you!

ham-infiltrators-trying-to-pick-the-lock.text: You need a thieving level of 23 in order to pick the lock of that trapdoor.

ham-infiltrators-trying-to-pick-the-lock.player: No, I'm not good enough at thieving.

ham-infiltrators-trying-to-pick-the-lock.speaker: Zanik
ham-infiltrators-trying-to-pick-the-lock.text: I'm not much good at thieving either, I'm afraid. You'd better get some practice.

ham-seek-talking-to-zanik-inside-the-tra.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-talking-to-zanik-inside-the-tra.text: The room where the HAM members make their plans must be down here somewhere. We've got to find it without getting caught!

ham-seek-getting-spotted-by-the-first-gu.speaker: Guard
ham-seek-getting-spotted-by-the-first-gu.text: Hey! Ordinary members aren't allowed here!

ham-seek-getting-spotted-by-the-first-gu.speaker: Guard
ham-seek-getting-spotted-by-the-first-gu.text: Go back upstairs and I'll say nothing about it. But if any of the other guards see you you're in big trouble!

ham-seek-getting-spotted-by-the-first-gu.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-getting-spotted-by-the-first-gu.text: whispers* Get him to face away from me...

ham-seek-talking-to-zanik-after-getting-.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-talking-to-zanik-after-getting-.text: whispers* Get that guard to turn his back on me. Maybe if you walk around him he'll keep facing you.

ham-seek-talking-to-the-guard.speaker: Guard
ham-seek-talking-to-the-guard.text: Ordinary members aren't allowed in this area. Get back to the cave above.

ham-seek-walking-past-the-first-guard.speaker: Guard
ham-seek-walking-past-the-first-guard.text: Hey! Where do you think you're going?

ham-seek-walking-past-the-first-guard.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-walking-past-the-first-guard.text: We can get through this if we work together, [player name]. But I can't get too close to the guards or they'll see I'm not human.

ham-seek-walking-past-the-first-guard.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-walking-past-the-first-guard.text: You've got to get them to turn their backs on me so I can shoot them without them seeing me draw my crossbow.

ham-seek-talking-to-zanik-after-seeing-h.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-talking-to-zanik-after-seeing-h.text: If you can get to the other side of that guard you can make him turn around so I can shoot him. Make sure another guard doesn't catch you though!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Okay.

options.condition: If Zanik has been told to wait

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Okay, let's go!

options.text: Isn't shooting people in the back wrong?

steps.player: Isn't shooting people in the back wrong?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Why more so than shooting them in the front?

options.text: How did you kill that guard in one hit?

steps.player: How did you kill that guard in one hit? I want to learn how to do that!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: It's a special technique with the bone crossbow. If we both get out of this alive I'll teach you, [player name]!

ham-seek-getting-spotted-by-the-guard-on.speaker: Guard
ham-seek-getting-spotted-by-the-guard-on.text: Hey! What are you doing here? Get out!

ham-seek-getting-spotted-by-the-guard-on.speaker: Guard
ham-seek-getting-spotted-by-the-guard-on.text: You there! You aren't allowed in here!

ham-seek-getting-caught-by-the-guards.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-getting-caught-by-the-guards.text: The guards caught you but I managed to slip away. Here, I'll let you out!

ham-seek-trying-to-squeeze-through-a-cra.text: You need an agility level of 23 to squeeze through that crack.

ham-seek-trying-to-squeeze-through-a-cra.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-trying-to-squeeze-through-a-cra.text: I don't think I could get through either. You'd better get some agility training done.

ham-seek-dealing-with-the-second-third-g.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-dealing-with-the-second-third-g.text: Is the coast clear to get past?

ham-seek-dealing-with-the-second-third-g.player: No, there's a guard patrolling the corridor.

ham-seek-dealing-with-the-second-third-g.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-dealing-with-the-second-third-g.text: I'll take care of him! Just tell me when his back is to us...

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: We got him, [player name]!

steps.text: Noo! He's seen us!

How did you kill that guard in one hit?

ham-seek-three-down-two-more-to-go.player: There are two more guards but I don't know how to get behind them.

ham-seek-three-down-two-more-to-go.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-three-down-two-more-to-go.text: Then maybe you could lead one of them past me...

options.text: Isn't shooting people in the back wrong?
How did you kill that guard in one hit?

ham-seek-near-the-eastern-guard.player: There are two more guards but I don't know how to get behind them.

ham-seek-near-the-eastern-guard.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-near-the-eastern-guard.text: That guard in the east corridor... if I wait at the end of the corridor then you could lead him past me...

options.text: Isn't shooting people in the back wrong?
How did you kill that guard in one hit?

ham-seek-deciding-the-plan-for-the-final.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-deciding-the-plan-for-the-final.text: I don't think that guard's going to move away from the door. I think we need to approach him from different directions...

options.text: Isn't shooting people in the back wrong?
How did you kill that guard in one hit?

ham-seek-dealing-with-the-final-guard.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-dealing-with-the-final-guard.text: That's the last of them! Now to listen to what's happening in the meeting room!

ham-seek-before-listening-at-the-door.player: There's no more guards! We've got them all!

ham-seek-before-listening-at-the-door.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-before-listening-at-the-door.text: I think I can hear something happening behind the double doors. We should listen.

options.text: Isn't shooting people in the back wrong?
How did you kill that guard in one hit?

ham-seek-listening-at-the-door.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-listening-at-the-door.text: They're saying something about... they're planning something... something about a machine...

ham-seek-listening-at-the-door.speaker: Zanik
ham-seek-listening-at-the-door.text: We've got to do something, [player name]! They're going to--

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-jimmy-.player: Did you see what happened to my friend?

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-jimmy-.speaker: Jimmy the Chisel
the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-jimmy-.text: There was a lot of commotion when they dragged you in here. There was someone else, she was struggling like anything. They said they'd take her outside. Dunno what happened to her then.

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-jimmy-.player: Oh no! I've got to find her!

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-a-ham-.text: If the player is in a HAM outfit:

steps.speaker: H.A.M. Guard
steps.text: Hello, brother, you fit in much better now that you're correctly attired. Before you stuck out like a sore thumb! Keep your eyes peeled though; I've heard there are thieves amongst us!

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-a-ham-.speaker: H.A.M. Guard
the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-a-ham-.text: Did you hear? They caught a goblin spy down in the store rooms!

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-a-ham-.player: What did you do to her?

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-a-ham-.speaker: H.A.M. Guard
the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-a-ham-.text: Oh, Sigmund and some of the guys took it upstairs and dealt with it. Can't have goblins coming down here!

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-a-ham-.speaker: H.A.M. Guard
the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-a-ham-.text: You should have seen how it was screaming for mercy! Those monsters aren't so tough when they're outnumbered twenty to one!

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-johanh.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-johanh.text: So, you got out of the cell? No matter...your goblin friend has already been dealt with...and Sigmund is on his way to deal with the rest of her foul brood!

the-power-of-the-tears-inspecting-zanik.text: But you notice that the mark on her forehead is glowing brightly.

the-power-of-the-tears-inspecting-zanik.player: Juna told Zanik that when the mark glowed again she should go to see her.
Perhaps I should take Zanik's body to Juna. I can't leave her here anyway!

steps.player: But I'll have to free up an inventory slot first.

the-power-of-the-tears-attempting-to-dro.player: I can't just leave Zanik's body lying around! I should take her to Juna.

the-power-of-the-tears-attempting-to-use.text: Doing that would be disrespectful to Zanik.

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-juna-a.speaker: Juna
the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-juna-a.text: That cannot be. She had not yet returned to learn of her destiny. The mark that the tears gave her had not begun to glow again.
You lay Zanik's corpse in front of Juna.

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-juna-a.speaker: Juna
the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-juna-a.text: This is indeed strange. I must commune with mighty Guthix and the forces of destiny.
Juna meditates for a few moments.

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-juna-a.speaker: Juna
the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-juna-a.text: Zanik's death was premature. The gods will allow it to be reversed.

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-juna-a.player: You can just bring her back to life?!

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-juna-a.speaker: Juna
the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-juna-a.text: The Tears of Guthix have powers beyond the understanding of mortals. They can restore her to life, with the gods' permission.
If the Tears of Guthix quest hasn't been completed:

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: You must collect some of the tears using Zanik's tear-bowl. Although I would not normally deem you worthy to collect the tears, I will let you into the cave for this special purpose.

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-juna-a.text: If the Tears of Guthix quest has been completed:

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: You must collect some of the tears using Zanik's tear-bowl. I will not count this against the next time you can collect the tears for yourself.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: You must have both hands free to carry the bowl. Speak to me again when your hands are free.
If the player's hands are free:

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Twenty tears should be sufficient. Collect twenty blue tears, but remember that green tears will decrease the amount of blue.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Then the forces of destiny must wait until a time that is more convenient for you.

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-juna-b.speaker: Juna
the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-juna-b.text: Zanik has not yet fulfilled her destiny, so the gods will allow her to be resurrected. You must collect some of the Tears of Guthix to allow this to happen.

steps.text: You must collect some of the tears using Zanik's tear-bowl. Although I would not normally deem you worthy to collect the tears, I will let you into the cave for this special purpose.

the-power-of-the-tears-talking-to-juna-b.text: If the Tears of Guthix quest has been completed:

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: You must collect some of the tears using Zanik's tear-bowl. I will not count this against the next time you can collect the tears for yourself.

the-power-of-the-tears-trying-to-exit-te.speaker: Juna
the-power-of-the-tears-trying-to-exit-te.text: You will need to collect twenty tears in order to resurrect Zanik.

options.text: I want to get out now!

steps.player: I want to get out now!

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: You have collected twenty tears.

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Juna
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: Then I will call upon their power.
Zanik hovers in the air before returning to life

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Zanik
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: Uuuhhh!

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Zanik
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: Get off me, you monsters!

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Zanik
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: What are you doing? Noo! Don't kill me! [player name], help me!

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Zanik
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: Oh!

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Zanik
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: They killed me, didn't they, [player name]?

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Zanik
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: Then what am I doing here?

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.player: Juna brought you back from the dead.

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Juna
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: Listen to me, Zanik. You are marked for a special purpose, and you have been granted new life so that you can carry it out. Your destiny is to lead all goblins into a new age.

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Zanik
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: But what does that mean?

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Juna
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: Someday you will know. But today you must hurry to foil the plot that even now threatens your home!

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Zanik
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: The plot! [player name], I've got to tell you what I heard outside the meeting room!
A flashback cutscene plays

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Zanik
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: Shh! I can hear them.

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Sigmund
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: Good news, brothers! Our tunnel from the water mill cellar has reached the cave goblin tunnels, and the last shipment of machinery is on its way from Keldagrim.

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: Do we have to deal with the dwarves? They may not exactly be monsters but they're still not human.

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: HAM member
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: If it wasn't for the King's tolerance of monsters, we humans would have a better industry than the dwarves!

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: H.A.M. Deacon
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: Well said, brother!

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Sigmund
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: I'll need to take some of the low-level members to help unload the machinery at the Lumbridge water mill.

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Johanhus Ulsbrecht
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: By all means. It's about time that lot made themselves useful.

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: Sigmund
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: Soon the mighty River Lum will wash away those evil goblins forever!

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: H.A.M. Deacon
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: Saradomin will surely bless us for destroying those abominations!

the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.speaker: All
the-power-of-the-tears-upon-collecting-t.text: Death to the Dorgeshuun!

showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-zanik.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-zanik.text: Let's go, [player name]! We've got to get to the Lumbridge water mill so we can foil Sigmund's plan!

options.text: I need to do something else for a bit.

steps.player: I need to do something else for a bit.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Do it quickly, [player name]! We've got to stop Sigmund from destroying my city!

options.text: What did Sigmund do to you?

steps.player: What did Sigmund do to you?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: It was horrible, [player name]!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: They didn't just k-kill me quickly. They were enjoying themselves. The light was so bright I couldn't see but I could hear them laughing...

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Let's get them, [player name]! I need to save my city and I want to get my revenge!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: It was... it wasn't like anything.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: One moment Sigmund and his thugs were... you know...

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: And then suddenly I was down in the cave and you were here. There was nothing in between.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: We Dorgeshuun don't believe in an afterlife. At least, if there is one we don't claim to know about it. And if anything happened to me while I was dead then I don't remember it.

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: And now my life's a mystery too. What was that destiny Juna talked about?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: But there's no time for that now. Let's get to the water mill!

showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-zanik-a.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-zanik-a.text: Quick, [player name]! Let's get to the water mill and stop Sigmund from destroying my home!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Okay!

showdown-with-sigmund-attempting-to-go-b.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-attempting-to-go-b.text: What are we going down there again for? We know where we need to go -- the Lumbridge water mill!

showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-zanik-a.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-zanik-a.text: We're not too late! They're still assembling the machine. Now we've got to find some way to get down there and stop them.

options.text: How can we get down there?

steps.player: How can we get down there?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I don't know. But there must be something around here we can use...

options.text: I need to do something else for a bit.
What did Sigmund do to you?

showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-kazgar.speaker: Kazgar
showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-kazgar.text: Hello, Zanik! Hello, surface-dweller! Would you like me to lead you to the mines?

showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-kazgar.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-kazgar.text: We've not got time to talk now, Kazgar! [player name], you've got to take me to the Lumbridge water mill at once!

steps.speaker: Dwarf
steps.text: None of your business! Those funny pink-robed people told me to keep it secret!

steps.speaker: Dwarf
steps.text: The guy who ordered all this? I don't see that's any of your business.

options.text: Why are you helping the HAM people?

steps.player: Why are you helping the HAM people?

steps.speaker: Dwarf
steps.text: What, these odd pink-robed people? Oh, the normal reason. Because they paid me.

steps.player: But don't you know what they're planning to do?

steps.speaker: Dwarf
steps.text: No, and I don't want to. Now go away!

showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-dwarf-w.speaker: Dwarf
showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-dwarf-w.text: Oh, it's another one of you funny people. Okay, grab one of the crates and take it downstairs. I told your boss how to put the parts together.

steps.speaker: Dwarf
steps.text: Didn't your boss tell you? It's a digging machine. Very special. Digs straight up, and can work without supervision when it's turned on.

steps.speaker: Dwarf
steps.text: What, your boss? He's downstairs waiting for you slackers to carry the rest of the crates down. So get a move on!

options.text: Why are you helping the HAM people?

steps.player: Why are you helping the HAM people?

steps.speaker: Dwarf
steps.text: Is that what you people call yourselves? Well, it's certainly not out of the goodness of my heart. Your boss paid good money for this machine, plus my fee for transporting it all this way.

steps.speaker: Dwarf
steps.text: So get to work and get it downstairs!

steps.speaker: Dwarf
steps.text: Oh, honestly! If you're not here to help then get out of the way!

showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-ham-whi.speaker: H.A.M. Member
showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-ham-whi.text: These crates are heavy! I could do with some help if that's what you're here for.

showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-enter-th.speaker: Dwarf
showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-enter-th.text: Where do you think you're going? Only people helping assemble the machine are allowed down there!

showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-enter-th.speaker: Dwarf
showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-enter-th.text: Hey! No goblins allowed down there!

showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-enter-th.speaker: Dwarf
showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-enter-th.text: Hey! What do you think you're doing going down there empty-handed? Get a crate and carry it down!

showdown-with-sigmund-searching-the-crat.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-searching-the-crat.text: Those must be the parts for the machine they're going to use to flood my city!

showdown-with-sigmund-searching-the-crat.player: Hey... if I carried one of these crates I could slip downstairs and stop them!

showdown-with-sigmund-searching-the-crat.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-searching-the-crat.text: Don't you dare go down there without me, [player name]! Find some way to get us both down there so I can face Sigmund myself!
The crate is full of machine parts.

showdown-with-sigmund-searching-an-empty.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-searching-an-empty.text: Are you thinking what I'm thinking, [player name]?

options.text: I don't know, what are you thinking?

steps.player: I don't know, what are you thinking?

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: I could hide in one of those crates, and then you could carry me downstairs as if you were carrying some of the machinery.
Zanik enters the crate and the player picks it up.
If the player is wielding something

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: You ought to free both your hands so you can carry the crate. I'm afraid I might be heavy!

showdown-with-sigmund-carrying-zanik-awa.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-carrying-zanik-awa.text: Why are we going away from the mill? We should get down there and save my city!

showdown-with-sigmund-attempting-to-summ.text: You can't drop your follower while holding the heavy crate.

showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-unlock-t.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-unlock-t.text: This must lead to the Dorgeshuun mines! Sigmund must mean the water to run through here and flood the city!

showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-unlock-t.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-unlock-t.text: We've got to stop him, [player name]!

showdown-with-sigmund-confronting-sigmun.speaker: Sigmund
showdown-with-sigmund-confronting-sigmun.text: [player name]! You and your goblin friend have interfered for the last time! Guards, kill them!

showdown-with-sigmund-confronting-sigmun.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-confronting-sigmun.text: I won't let you destroy my home, Sigmund!

showdown-with-sigmund-confronting-sigmun.speaker: Sigmund
showdown-with-sigmund-confronting-sigmun.text: Saradomin protect me from this foul goblin!

showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-smash-th.text: You should deal with Sigmund first.

showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-leave-th.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-leave-th.text: Don't leave me, [player name]! I can't defeat Sigmund without you!

steps.speaker: Zanik
steps.text: Hurry, [player name]!

showdown-with-sigmund-re-entering-the-wa.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-re-entering-the-wa.text: [player name]! Thank goodness you're all right! Now let's finish off Sigmund and his cronies before they flood the city!

showdown-with-sigmund-defeating-sigmund.speaker: Sigmund
showdown-with-sigmund-defeating-sigmund.text: Curse you, Player, and your goblin friend! You win this time, but we will meet again!

showdown-with-sigmund-defeating-sigmund.player: He must have had a ring of life! It looks like he got away from us this time, Zanik.

showdown-with-sigmund-defeating-sigmund.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-defeating-sigmund.text: The important thing is we stopped him! Now let's smash that machine and then get back to Dorgesh-Kaan!

showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-zanik-b.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-zanik-b.text: Quick, [player name], let's smash that drilling machine before Sigmund returns! Then we can return to Dorgesh- Kaan for a hero's welcome!

showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-unlock-t.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-unlock-t.text: We can't just leave that machine there for someone else to complete! We should smash it beyond repair before returning home!

showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-leave-vi.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-trying-to-leave-vi.text: There's no need to go that way, [player name]! We can go south along the tunnel to the Dorgeshuun mine.

showdown-with-sigmund-smashing-the-machi.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-smashing-the-machi.text: Now let's get back to Dorgesh-Kaan to tell them what happened! We can go south along the tunnel Sigmund has dug.

showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-zanik-a.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-talking-to-zanik-a.text: We did it, [player name]! My city is safe! Now we can follow that tunnel south back to the mines!

showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-and-return.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-and-return.text: Where did you go? We should follow the tunnel south to Dorgesh-Kaan!

showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.text: I'll show you the way through to the city. Wait till we tell Mistag about what happened!
~ [player name] and Zanik return victorious to the Dorgeshuun mine ~

showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.speaker: Ur-tag
showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.text: Welcome back, Zanik. What have you to report?

showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.text: The city is safe! The HAM group was plotting against us, but we stopped them!

showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.speaker: Ur-tag
showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.text: You stopped them this time, but the surface still poses a danger. The council has been debating how much contact we should have with it, and wants you to make a recommendation.

showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.text: The surface is a strange and wonderful place! We should embrace it, not shut ourselves off!

showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.text: And not all surface-dwellers are bad. Without [player name] the city would have been destroyed for sure!

showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.speaker: Ur-tag
showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.text: [player name], we are in your debt once again.

showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.speaker: Ur-tag
showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.text: The council has voted that, if Zanik's recommendation was positive, humans from Lumbridge should be allowed into the city. You may now enter Dorgesh-Kaan!

showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.text: This is brilliant! I'm sure you won't regret this!

showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.text: Thank you for taking me on that adventure, [player name]! I'll show you how to use the bone crossbow like I promised I would!
Zanik shows you how to use the bone crossbow's special attack.

showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.speaker: Zanik
showdown-with-sigmund-leaving-through-th.text: Come find me in the city if you ever want to chat, [player name]. I'm going to go and think about what Juna said about my destiny. I don't know what it will involve, but I have a feeling we will adventure together again!
If the player left the water mill cellar without a light source:

steps.text: Zanik gives you a torch so you can see.

jump-77d6025a9df7428b.player: Where do I get the robes?

jump-77d6025a9df7428b.speaker: Zanik
jump-77d6025a9df7428b.text: How should I know? You're the surface-dweller! Maybe you could steal them from the HAM people or something.

jump-77d6025a9df7428b.speaker: Zanik
jump-77d6025a9df7428b.text: We'll need two sets of full robes: shirt, robe, hood, cloak, gloves, boots and badge.

jump-28693edc982b52b0.player: Aren't you scared of the surface?

jump-28693edc982b52b0.speaker: Zanik
jump-28693edc982b52b0.text: Well... a bit. All our legends say it's a terrible place.

jump-28693edc982b52b0.speaker: Zanik
jump-28693edc982b52b0.text: But that's a bad reason not to visit it. Maybe the legends are wrong. Or even if they're right, we should know for sure.

jump-28693edc982b52b0.speaker: Zanik
jump-28693edc982b52b0.text: And I've always wondered... what's beyond the next cave? What's at the end of every tunnel? The surface is a whole new world to explore, and I can't wait!

jump-d09c1e677b943ea0.player: What's that mark on your forehead?

jump-d09c1e677b943ea0.speaker: Zanik
jump-d09c1e677b943ea0.text: To be honest I don't know. It happened when...

jump-d09c1e677b943ea0.speaker: Zanik
jump-d09c1e677b943ea0.text: If you don't mind, I'd rather not talk about it now. Maybe once you've shown me some of the surface.

jump-5a3feac05aa7e631.player: I need to do something else for a bit.

jump-5a3feac05aa7e631.speaker: Zanik
jump-5a3feac05aa7e631.text: All right. I'll wait for you in the castle cellar.

jump-56a3fac82d2668ea.player: Aren't you going to put on your disguise?

jump-56a3fac82d2668ea.speaker: Zanik
jump-56a3fac82d2668ea.text: There's no need for that yet. Why don't you show me around Lumbridge first? I'm so excited about visiting the surface!

jump-14d3a251967b310f.speaker: Zanik
jump-14d3a251967b310f.text: I will tell you, [player name], but not just yet. Finish showing me around Lumbridge and then I'll tell you.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Sure thing! Most armour you can craft just involves taking a needle and some thread to whatever material you can get your hands on.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: You might like to try with different kinds of animal hide, from cows, yaks, snakes, dragons... Or any other sort of fabric you can find!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Some crafty types have started making some leather- covered wooden shields recently, too!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: You might find some creatures make for a pretty sturdy helmet, too. The best way to make something like that's just to take a good old chisel to it!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Would you like to hear about anything else I mentioned?

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Of course! Pottery's all kind of the same, it just takes a lot of getting used to.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: All that there really is to it is getting your hands on some clay, getting it wet and getting to work on a potter's wheel.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Once you've got the shape you want out of it, you want to put it in a pottery oven to fire it up.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: The barbarians west of Varrock seem to be pretty keen on their pottery. I'd take a look around there, if you wanted to try it out!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Once you get the hang of it, you can make pots, pie dishes, bowls... You know.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Would you like to hear about anything else I mentioned?

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Glass blowing? Well, to get started you'll need to get yourself some molten glass. You can make some for yourself by heating sand and soda ash in a furnace.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Once you've got a hold of that, you'll want a glass blowing pipe to blow it out in to shape, before it cools down.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: It's not the easiest thing to get to grips with, but it shouldn't be too difficult!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Would you like to hear about anything else I mentioned?

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Sure. All it boils down to is a bar of gold or silver, some kind of cut gem if you're feeling fancy, and a mould to help shape the thing.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: You can use a chisel to make a gem really shine and sparkle. You wouldn't want to use an uncut one for any jewellery.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Once you've got all of your materials together, you'll want to use a furnace to actually craft whatever it is you're trying to make!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Wizards seem to like enchanting their jewellery to do all kinds of things, too, but I don't know a lot about that.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Would you like to hear about anything else I mentioned?

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Well, there aren't too many weapons that people tend to craft, but there are a couple worth noting!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Battlestaves are probably the most common. It boils down to fastening an orb of some kind onto the end of a battlestaff.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: You do need to get the orb in the first place, though... You can make one through glass blowing, but it's not much use without being charged.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: I can't help much with crafting it, though! There's a little more magic involved there than I'm familiar with.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Aside from battlestaves, there are a couple of weapons that people like to make from silver... Sickles and bolts, usually.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Would you like to hear about anything else I mentioned?

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you want to know?

options.text: How can I train my crafting?

jump-45b208c92071065c.player: How can I train my crafting?

jump-45b208c92071065c.text: If the player has level 1-9 Crafting:

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: To get started, you might like to try your hand at crafting some armour from cow's leather. There's a tanner just over in Al Kharid who could tan any hides for you.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Once you've managed to get your hand on some kind of leather, you just need a needle and some thread to get to work!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: If that doesn't take your fancy, you could try your hand at spinning wool right here on the spinning wheel.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Come to think of it... Farmer Fred, just north of here, sounds like he could use a hand shearing some of his sheep. Maybe you could help him out, and get some practice while you're at it.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you want to know?

jump-45b208c92071065c.text: If the player has level 10-19 Crafting:

steps.player: How can I train my crafting?

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Lots of budding craftsmen seem to spend their time here spinning Flax into bow strings on the wheel, if that takes your fancy.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Or you might like to try your hand at crafting some armour from cow's leather. There's a tanner just over in Al Kharid who could tan any hides for you.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Is there anything else you want to know?

jump-45b208c92071065c.text: If the player has level 20-99 Crafting:

steps.text: If the player has below 99 Crafting:

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Now that you've got a little experience under your belt, the world's your oyster!
If the player has 99 Crafting:

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: I can't help but feel like I should be the one asking you! At this point, the world's your oyster!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: If you wanted to try your hand at making some jewellery, you'll want to get your hand on some gold and some kind of gem, with a mould to work with and a chisel at hand.

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: But if that's not your thing, maybe you'd like to try making some more armour!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Cow's leather's a good place to start, but you can try all other kinds of hides, like a dragon's!

steps.speaker: Crafting tutor
steps.text: Glass blowing seems to be a popular trade, too. You can forge molten glass from some sand and soda ash, then make all kinds of things using a glass blowing pipe.

Almost every tree can be chopped down. Normal logs will be produced by chopping 'Trees' and Oak logs will come from chopping 'Oak Trees'. You can find Oak trees in amongst normal trees scattered about the lands.
Willow trees will yield willow logs. You'll find willows like to grow near water, you can find some south of Draynor.
Maple logs can be gleaned from Maple trees. You'll usually find Maple trees standing alone amongst other trees.
Yew trees are few and far between. We do our best to cultivate them. Look for the tree icon on your minimap to find rare trees. Try North of Port Sarim.

options.condition: If the player has level 29-98 Woodcutting

steps.text: Magic trees are... magic. A difficult wood to work with, but worth it for the rewards. Find them in the areas south of Seers village or on the East side of the Mage Arena.

steps.speaker: Woodsman tutor
steps.text: Hollow trees can be found in the Haunted Woods east of Canifis, but be careful of the leeches.
Bronze axes are easy to get, simply go visit Bob in his shop in Lumbridge, or talk to me if you have mislaid yours.

steps.speaker: Woodsman tutor
steps.text: As you progress in your combat skill you will find you can wield your woodcutting axe as a weapon, it's not very effective, but it frees up a slot for another log.
As your woodcutting skill increases you will find yourself able to use better axes to chop trees faster.... anything up to steel you can buy from Bob's axe shop.
Rune axes can be player made with very high level smithing and mining. They can also be obtained through killing one of the fearsome tree spirits, though this is very rare.

jump-d6386fd05e10dae4.speaker: Magic combat tutor
jump-d6386fd05e10dae4.text: You will need a talisman for the rune you would like to create. You can right-click on it and select the Locate option. This will tell you the rough location of the altar.

jump-d6386fd05e10dae4.speaker: Magic combat tutor
jump-d6386fd05e10dae4.text: When you find the ruined altar, use the talisman on it to be transported to a temple where you can craft your runes.

jump-d6386fd05e10dae4.speaker: Magic combat tutor
jump-d6386fd05e10dae4.text: Clicking on the temple's altar will imbue your rune essence with the altar's magical property.

jump-d6386fd05e10dae4.speaker: Magic combat tutor
jump-d6386fd05e10dae4.text: If you want to save yourself an inventory space, you could always try binding the talisman to a tiara.

jump-d6386fd05e10dae4.speaker: Magic combat tutor
jump-d6386fd05e10dae4.text: To make one, take a tiara and talisman to the ruins and use the tiara on the temple altar. This will bind the talisman to your tiara.

jump-d6386fd05e10dae4.speaker: Magic combat tutor
jump-d6386fd05e10dae4.text: Is there anything else you would like to know?

jump-bf15c9d2f58861fc.speaker: Melee combat tutor
jump-bf15c9d2f58861fc.text: Well let me see now...There are stabbing type weapons such as daggers, then you have swords which are slashing, maces that have great crushing abilities, battle axes which are powerful.

jump-bf15c9d2f58861fc.speaker: Melee combat tutor
jump-bf15c9d2f58861fc.text: It depends a lot on how you want to fight. Experiment and find out what is best for you. Never be scared to try out a new weapon; you never know, you might like it!

jump-bf15c9d2f58861fc.speaker: Melee combat tutor
jump-bf15c9d2f58861fc.text: While I tried all of them for a while, I settled on this rather good sword.

jump-bf15c9d2f58861fc.speaker: Melee combat tutor
jump-bf15c9d2f58861fc.text: You might also find that different weapon types are more accurate against different monsters.

jump-bf15c9d2f58861fc.speaker: Melee combat tutor

The world map opens and pans to the location of the Al Kharid mine.
Clay can be mined in many places. Try south west of Varrock or the crafting guild. See the crafting tutor upstairs in Lumbridge Castle for more information on what you can make with clay.
Rune Essence can only be mined at secret places... I don't know where these are but you can speak to the Duke of Lumbridge to find out more.

steps.speaker: Mining tutor
steps.text: You can make all sorts of things from clay, if you have the crafting skill. Rune Essence is used for magic to cast spells.
Rocks which yield copper ore can be found around here, and other places such as Al Kharid, Rimmington or Varrock mines. They're quite common.
Tin ore is much the same as copper. It can be found around this area as well as Varrock, Al Kharid and the Barbarian Village.
Iron can be mined around Rimmington, Al Kharid and Varrock. It's tricky to smelt though - see the boy at the furnace in Lumbridge for tips.
Look for this icon on your minimap to find the furnace.
You'll need to be a fairly good miner before you can start mining coal. You can find it in the Dwarf mine, Al Kharid and quite a few other places.
Silver can be mined to help you with your crafting. You can find it in the Crafting guild, Al Kharid and many other mines.
Gold requires quite a lot of experience in mining before you can successfully extract it from the rocks. It can be found in Al Kharid, the Crafting guild, Rimmington and other places.
Mithril and Adamantite rocks are fairly rare and require great skill to mine. You can find them in Al Kharid, the Dwarven mines, Lumbridge Swamps and other places.
Runite is the most prized of ores and is very rare. I'll leave you to find where to mine it.

The Bronze Pick is your basic tool of the trade. You can buy one from Bob's Axe shop very cheaply, that's north of here in Lumbridge, I also heard that exploring the castle walls may yield a surprise or two.
The Iron and Steel Picks are faster than the bronze pickaxe, but you will need to progress with your mining a little before you can use them. You can buy them from Nurmof in the Dwarven mines.
Mithril, Adamantite, and Rune Picks may be used as you progress with your skill of mining. They can be obtained from Nurmof in the Dwarven mines.

jump-14fa1bdcb093445e.speaker: Candle seller
jump-14fa1bdcb093445e.text: Out of glass.  The more advanced lanterns have a metal component as well.

jump-14fa1bdcb093445e.speaker: Candle seller
jump-14fa1bdcb093445e.text: Firstly you can make a simple candle lantern out of glass.  It's just like a candle, but the flame isn't exposed, so it's safer.

jump-14fa1bdcb093445e.speaker: Candle seller
jump-14fa1bdcb093445e.text: Then you can make an oil lamp, which is brighter but has an exposed flame.  But if you make an iron frame for it you can turn it into an oil lantern.

jump-14fa1bdcb093445e.speaker: Candle seller
jump-14fa1bdcb093445e.text: Finally there's the bullseye lantern.  You'll need to make a frame out of steel and add a glass lens.

jump-14fa1bdcb093445e.speaker: Candle seller
jump-14fa1bdcb093445e.text: Once you've made your lamp or lantern, you'll need to make lamp oil for it.  The chemist near Rimmington has a machine for that.

jump-14fa1bdcb093445e.speaker: Candle seller
jump-14fa1bdcb093445e.text: For any light source, you'll need a tinderbox to light it. Keep your tinderbox handy in case it goes out!

jump-14fa1bdcb093445e.speaker: Candle seller
jump-14fa1bdcb093445e.text: But if all that's too complicated, you can buy a candle right here for 1000 gold!
